name: EMCC
recent: EMCC 最近获得四张典当执照，将业务扩展至东马。公司也宣布派发每股 0.6 仙的中期股息，除息日为 2026 年 9 月 8 日。此外，公司通过 ESOS 行使发行新股，并有一名高管行使期权。
notable: 获得四张典当执照，扩展业务至东马。
宣布每股 0.6 仙中期股息。
通过 ESOS 行使发行 1,011,700 股新股。
risks: 首席执行官行使 ESOS 期权，交易 289,800 股。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度营收为 5949 万令吉，环比下降 12.0%，但同比增长 21.9%；净利为 1386.5 万令吉，环比增长 1.1%，同比增长 49.6%；净利率为 23.3%，高于上一季度的 20.3%。

recent_en: EMCC recently secured four pawnbroking licences to expand into East Malaysia. The company also declared an interim dividend of 0.6 sen per share, with ex-date on 8 Sep 2026. In addition, new shares were issued via ESOS exercise, and a senior executive exercised options.
notable_en: Secured four pawnbroking licences to expand into East Malaysia.
Declared interim dividend of 0.6 sen per share.
Issued 1,011,700 new shares via ESOS exercise.
risks_en: CEO exercised ESOS options involving 289,800 shares.
earnings_en: Q2 2026 revenue was MYR 59.49 million, down 12.0% QoQ but up 21.9% YoY; net income was MYR 13.865 million, up 1.1% QoQ and 49.6% YoY; net margin was 23.3%, higher than 20.3% in the previous quarter.
